scope: Frozen v1 masks. Each scenario averages eligible forecast origins, seed replicas averaged per physical configuration. Distributions pool eligible physical configurations; all ten disjoint test folds pooled once across2080histories/2040configurations; no nested-size comparison; percentage denominators are grouped means. Ties use 1e-12 + 1e-6*baseline MAE. Event timing uses positive gas only, raw states retained for invalidity; undefined timing explicitly counted. No training or test-driven selection.
